simple.meaning: צָחַח (tsâchach) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to glare , i.e. be dazzling white.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Lamentations, beginning at Lamentations 4:7. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.

definitions.short: to glare , i.e. be dazzling white
definitions.full: H6705. tsachach [ צָחַח ] verb be dazzling ( צַחְצַח ᵑ7 polish ; Syriac be scorched , Aph`el declare in writing (make clear), clarus, lucidus, fulgidus ; , , smooth, plain ); — Qal Perfect 3plural מֵחָלָב צַחוּ Lam 4:7 (|| מִשֶּׁלֶג זַכּוּ ), they are more dazzling (i.e. whiter ) than milk (of effeminate skin).

occurrences.englishText: Her nobles were purer than snow.
